description: Search prediction markets by keyword: one result per matching Polymarket event, its representative market (the market whose title is q, else a moneyline or winner market before an O/U, spread or alt line), so a game's spreads, totals and player props never appear as separate results. An event holding a market whose title is q (case-insensitive) ranks first whatever its date, so a pasted market title returns that market first. Polymarket's polyv2 copy of a game is left out when the game itself is stored, as in get_game. Pass a sports result's event_slug to list_game_markets for every market of that game, or its condition_id to get_market_flow. Cursor-paginated; a page can hold fewer than limit results while has_more is true.

category.description: Filter by category. One category such as Basketball or Esports; the word sports is rejected, so omit category for every sports and esports market

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor; send it with the same q, status and category

q.description: Search query (2-512 characters before whitespace trimming, with at least 2 letters or digits; a query with fewer returns 400 bad_request)

name: search_markets
title: Search Markets
